name: AI Email Auto-Responder with Ollama
description: Classifies incoming emails, filters spam, and drafts context-aware replies using Ollama local AI. No external API keys required.

setup: After import, start the schedule: cdecli cron activate ai-email-auto-responder-with-ollama.

hints: "Get Unread Emails (IMAP)": the original used Mailbox (IMAP original); check the mapped googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_FETCH_EMAILS params before running.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
